description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating RenderScript intrinsics for image processing effects such as blur, convolve, and color matrix transformations, with UI controls for effect selection and parameter adjustment.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing image processing effects using RenderScript, with UI controls for effect selection and parameter adjustment.

classes.name: RenderScriptTask
classes.description: AsyncTask subclass for performing RenderScript image filtering operations asynchronously.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, creates RenderScript context, loads bitmaps, and sets up effect controls.

methods.name: createScript
methods.description: Initializes RenderScript context and creates intrinsic scripts for blur, convolve, and color matrix effects.

methods.name: performFilter
methods.description: Applies selected RenderScript intrinsic filter to input bitmap with specified parameter.

methods.name: getFilterParameter
methods.description: Converts UI slider progress (0-100) into effect-specific parameter value.

methods.name: updateImage
methods.description: Cancels previous filter task and starts a new asynchronous filtering operation with current parameters.

methods.name: loadBitmap
methods.description: Loads a bitmap resource with ARGB_8888 configuration.

methods.name: createThumbnail
methods.description: Creates small thumbnail images for each effect mode and assigns them to UI radio buttons.
